description: **A launch is not counted for about 1 s**: `warscape/jobq.py` `capped_sessions` needs a pid, and a session just launched is `working` with no pid until about +1.2 s. Have `JobServer` remember its own launches for a few seconds and count them. Why: A second button press in that window, or one during a tick, goes over the cap by one. Measured with a throwaway session, 2026-11-06. Raised: W41 review round 1, Later 1, 2026-11-06
title: A launch is not counted for about 1 s
